verdict_scope: Code review only. No remaining directly evidenced P0/P1 code finding in the review repairs. This is not final performance acceptance or merge approval.

previous_findings.issue: Custom Provider + logged-in Metask image bearer causes Run acquire/release security reset
previous_findings.evidence: Real Account/Models/Custom Provider/canonical AgentCore/loopback HTTP image Product case verifies identical security epoch before admission and after the owned image execution is released. Unit/lifecycle tests additionally exercise duplicate rejection, a genuinely new value and Account rotation, direct redaction and escaped JSON during frozen preparation.

previous_findings.issue: Same credential execution reinstall revokes unchanged projections
previous_findings.evidence: Exact source identity, protocol, target and credential comparison retains current read for equivalent reinstall. Changed source, target or credential still makes old read stale. Model/execution generation churn does not grant or revoke unrelated projection access.

String-only canonical wire IDs, string-only management enum and integer-token-only runLimit. Native negative cases cover numeric arrays, numeric strings, decimal/exponent tokens, numeric enum tags and noncanonical decimal IDs.

previous_findings.issue: Three strict Renderer decoder branches had no assertions
previous_findings.evidence: Negative tests isolate and assert the specific visible-Task deletion, active Compact identity and disabled MCP baseline guard; unrelated summary failures cannot satisfy the assertions.

previous_findings.issue: Transport withdrawal leaves Product read plan retained
previous_findings.evidence: A scoped cancellation capability carries exact Product read identity. Replacement/security withdrawal/connection close/invalid descriptor invoke cancellation once. Product ignores stale cancellation IDs so an old transport cannot revoke a newer plan.

Command refresh follows a fresh installed current scope; explicit scope read has typed supersession. Actual connection tests exercise repeated page replacement, stale result discard, serialized reads and second-CAS continuation from the newly installed context, plus bootstrap and genuine failure handling.

previous_findings.issue: Same-Task history refill loses reading position
previous_findings.evidence: Mounted TaskContent DOM geometry test reproduces continuous suffix shrink and scroll clamp, then restores the same Run and viewport offset after preceding content height changes. Existing Task-switch, follow-latest and prepend behaviors remain covered.

previous_findings.issue: Scratch files and temporary-only raw evidence
previous_findings.evidence: Scratch ignored, files retained, historical and current raw records embedded in durable JSON with original byte hashes; historical failed measurement and historical evidence JSON remain unchanged.

boundaries.Account: Owns access token and authorization generation. Main-thread visitor exposes a call-scoped inspection capability only; refresh token never enters Product. Product detaches the capability before Account teardown.
boundaries.Product: Owns sanitization, exact known-value checks, frozen credential copies, projection cache, preparation and exact read cancellation. Frozen read copies are bounded and cleared. Security synchronization remains on Account commit, never Renderer polling.
boundaries.Bridge: Owns token validation and transport descriptor/bytes; scoped cancellation only calls the Product read API and carries no credential or business authority.
boundaries.Renderer: Owns consumer scopes, typed supersession and ephemeral reading anchors. Does not decide execution scheduling, credential security or Product history authority.
